'''Attis Station''' was a research facility located on the poisonous [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Quesh]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of [[3642 BBY]], the research lab was attacked by [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] forces, and the scientists and personnel were captured and held hostage. Fortunately for them, the newly appointed [[The Barsen'thor|Barsen'thor]] [[Mission to Attis Station|arrived]], and with assistance from [[Nadia Grell]], managed to defeat the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] threat, and save a large majority of the staff. The facility had two floors, as well as testing rooms.

{{Struct-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Attis Station appears in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] MMORPG ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a primary location on Quesh.
